visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large crowd of people is gathered outdoors in front of a stage, many holding up colorful patterned towels. The words '2025年夏天' are prominently displayed over the footage. (2) A wide aerial drone shot shows a woman in a red swimsuit running across a sandy beach next to turquoise ocean waves. Text appears overlaying the scene. (3) The scene shifts back to the festival where people are holding up smartphones to record. A person in a grey hoodie stands on a raised platform, holding a microphone high above the cheering crowd. (4) Graphic overlays introduce featured artists including 玖壹壹 (a group of three men in suits), 呂士軒 (a man with a shaved head and sunglasses), and the group Young Posse. (5) Fast cuts show vibrant street scenes at night with neon lights and daytime shots of white market tents set up in a field with palm trees. (6) A person's hand holds a bowl of fried food topped with onions. A young woman is shown eating a large bun and then a steamed dumpling, looking satisfied. (7) A man and a woman stand atop a large, green moss-covered rock in the middle of shallow sea water. (8) The final scene displays a comprehensive graphic poster of the 'SSR South Sound Rock' event with a full list of performing artists and event dates.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male narrator speaking at a rapid pace over a driving electronic dance music (EDM) track. A high-frequency synthesizer hook is prominent, accompanied by distant, low-volume cheering from a crowd. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect punctuates the narration as the speaker emphasizes the festival's location. The music maintains a constant 4/4 beat with high percussive energy. (3) The vocal intensity increases as the narrator lists artist names, each name followed by a subtle rhythmic accent in the music. The overall acoustic brightness is high, emphasizing a sharp, clear broadcast quality. (4) A percussive 'hit' sound effect marks the transition into the discussion of food and lifestyle. The background music remains upbeat, blending rock elements with digital textures. (5) The narrator shouts '免門票!' with high emotional arousal, followed by an rising synth riser effect. The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic call to action and a brief fade-out of the music and crowd noise.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Presentation (Lineup) -> Experience Highlights (Food/Beach) -> Logistics (Free/Location) -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for the 'SSR South Sound Rock' music festival in Kenting. It uses rapid visual montages and enthusiastic narration to showcase the event's core appeals: a diverse international artist lineup, a beautiful beach setting, local food markets, and the key selling point that the event is completely free of charge. It aims to generate excitement and encourage viewers to travel to Kenting for the summer event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct promotion of the event name, dates, location, and performing artists with a clear call to action to attend and tag friends.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video exhibits high production value typical of social media marketing, utilizing synchronized audio-visual beats and dense text overlays to maintain high viewer engagement throughout its short duration.
